design_premises_found_false.claim: F9/N4: open the file, fstat the descriptor, refuse a FIFO; the open and read run under the 3 s root
design_premises_found_false.finding: os.Open of a FIFO blocks in open(2) before any fstat (probe: 'os.Open: BLOCKED >2s in open'; with O_NONBLOCK: 'opened; regular=false mode=prw-r--r--'); a context does not bound os.Open/Read; the design's 'Lstat instead of f.Stat' mutant is not killed by a FIFO arm without a concurrent swap
design_premises_found_false.resolution: M3/sprint 2 only (Appendix A A-D1, A-D8): os.OpenFile(path, O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK) as episode_launch_interactive.go:252 does; mutants 'O_NONBLOCK dropped' and 'IsRegular dropped' replace it

design_premises_found_false.claim: §2.10a code sketch: confirmApproverAct uses readTermLineWithin; 'EOF and read failure: line == ""'
design_premises_found_false.finding: contradicts the same section's [r2] reader contract and V39 (ReadString returns partial bytes with the error; readTermLine trims and drops it)
design_premises_found_false.resolution: M3/sprint 2 (Appendix A A-D2): readTermLineErrWithin returns the raw line and error; confirm only on ok && err == nil && HasSuffix(line, "\n") && isYes(line)
